name: Sandy
bio:
Sandy, a highly skilled Sydney-based tattoo artist specializing in intricate dotwork, has garnered a reputation for their impeccable attention to detail and precision. As a resident artist at Ink Culture, with license number 104380, Sandy provides a professional service, ensuring that every client leaves with a piece of art that truly embodies their personal style and vision. Their expertise in dotwork ensures each tattoo is a masterful display of patience and technique, solidifying Sandy's status as an adept artist in the field.
